title: The Mystery Call
narration: A single note—52 Hertz. Higher than any whale song. Detected since 1989. [gasp] But no one’s ever seen the singer. The mystery only deepens with every passing year. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: A dark ocean abyss. A lone hydrophone picks up a deep, resonant pulse in blue-green waves. The frequency graph spikes at 52Hz. Fade to black.

title: The Lone Frequency
narration: Blue whales hum at 10-40Hz. Fin whales at 20Hz. This? 52Hz. A voice out of place. [chuckle] Like a violin in a drumline. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: Split screen: left side shows a blue whale’s deep call (10-40Hz waveform), right side shows the 52Hz spike. A cartoon violin appears over the spike.

title: The SOSUS Secret
narration: The U.S. Navy’s SOSUS array—meant to track submarines—heard it first. A whale singing at 52Hz. No match. No species. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: A vintage sonar screen flickers with the 52Hz signal. The word 'SOSUS' glows in military green. Fade to a whale silhouette with a question mark.

title: The Unanswered Call
narration: Decades of tracking. 3,000 kilometers of ocean. Still—no visual sighting. [sigh] A voice echoes. No answer. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: Aerial shot of the Pacific Ocean. A red dot pulses at the center. No whale breaches. Just waves. Fade to a lone hydrophone in the deep.

title: The Irregular Rhythm
narration: Minutes. Hours. The gaps between calls stretch. No pattern. No rhythm. Just a lonely pulse in the dark. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: A stopwatch ticks. The 52Hz spike appears randomly on a timeline. The stopwatch glitches—time feels broken.

title: The Decibel Mystery
narration: 155 decibels. Louder than a jet engine. Yet no one hears it. Why? Because it’s singing to an empty ocean. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: A jet engine roars in the distance. The sound wave distorts. Cut to the 52Hz spike—silent, alone.

title: The Nickname
narration: They call it 52 Blue. A name for the loneliest voice in the sea. A voice that’s never found its match. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: A handwritten tag '52 Blue' floats in the ocean. The tag dissolves into the whale’s silhouette. Fade to black.

title: The Educational Echo
narration: Schools play its calls. Scientists study its mystery. But the ocean stays silent. No reply. Just the echo of 52 Hertz. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: A classroom screen shows the 52Hz waveform. A child points at it. The waveform pulses. Fade to the deep ocean again.

title: The Unanswered Question
narration: Is it lost? Is it alone? Or is it singing to a world that doesn’t listen? The ocean keeps its secret. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: The hydrophone dips into the abyss. The 52Hz spike fades into the darkness. Fade to black.

title: The Last Pulse
narration: 52 Hertz. Since 1989. Still singing. Still waiting. The loneliest voice in the ocean. [whisper] Will it ever be heard? The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: A final shot: the 52Hz spike glows faintly in the deep. The screen fades to black. Silence.
